user_query: I'm a huge fan of music and I'm looking for some new tracks to listen to. Can you recommend me some popular songs from the Mexico Songs chart? Also, provide me with the basic information and download link for a track called 'The Phoenix' by one of the Hot 100 Artists on SoundCloud.

TaskList.description: Query the current Mexico Songs chart to get a list of popular songs.
Select a few top songs from the Mexico chart to recommend to the user.
Search for the track 'The Phoenix' by a Hot 100 Artist on SoundCloud and retrieve its basic information.
Get the download link for 'The Phoenix' track on SoundCloud.
